en.topic_title: Policy Address 2026: Greenpeace criticises lack of wetland protection in Northern Metropolis development plan
en.topic_summary:
Greenpeace Hong Kong has criticised plans for the Northern Metropolis development project, saying that the blueprint lacks protections for sensitive wetlands near the city’s border with mainland China. 



Hong Kong Chief Executive John Lee (centre) attends a press conference after delivering the city’s first five-year plan and his annual Policy Address on September 16, 2026. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP.
